QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` off (default) | `calloc` / `free`, macro-mapped in `platform.h:166`
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer treats MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY as the option that enables substitution and says it is off by default. It never says the option is commented out in the shipped mbedtls_config.h, and "off (default)" is not that specific claim.
